title: How This Woman’s Combative Behavior Landed Her in Cuffs
description:
Florida deputies received a call about a “combative patient” at a healthcare facility where they met Natasha Walker. Not only was Natasha unhappy to see law enforcement, but she shifted her combative demeanor towards them. She was charged with two counts of battering a law enforcement officer and one count of resisting arrest, to which she pleaded no contest.
